title: B=また outer-frame morphology review
purpose: Re-evaluate the v0.64 B=また spring/plants outer-frame lane using Yamauchi's surfaced transcription and lexical analysis, without treating equal kana as morphology identity.

source_contexts.title: 小松引
source_contexts.local_transcription: しける葉の またひけよもつ まこのての こまつもよけひ 玉のはるけし

lexical_evidence.note: The surfaced transcription preserves また immediately before ひけ. Current evidence does not establish that this また is the same 待た- morphology as poem 10.

source_contexts.title: 草木花
source_contexts.local_transcription: はるのみと またるるけしき さく花は くさきしけるる 玉とみのるは

lexical_evidence.note: Yamauchi's lexical analysis explicitly gives 待た(るる), so this B is morphologically anchored as the verb stem 待た-.

evidence_source.author: 山内潤三
evidence_source.title: 廻文歌の限界と効用（下）―高野山釈教長歌を頂点として―

finding.reason: Poem 10 explicitly supports 待た-, whereas poem 1 does not yet have an equivalent B-level parse. Raw B=また equality cannot establish a shared morphology node.

candidate_impact.reason: The outer-frame swap would join source contexts across B=また before morphology equivalence is established.
Reverse directed swap has the same unresolved shared-B identity premise.

regression_value.principle: equal palindrome-cell kana do not imply morphology identity
regression_value.relation_to_v100: Independent B-slot analogue of the D=みつ normalization/source-identity guard; here the risk is source-specific morphology rather than devoicing normalization.

decision.next_lane: Review the source-specific D=むす corridor, prioritizing hybrid-007.
